body_html: What an incredibly coincidental experience at the Schreiner wedding tonight! I arrived at the Catholic Church in Glennwood Springs to set up for the reception and was impressed by the video game themed tables, cake, and decor of the room. As the guests filtered in I became even more impressed with the people that were attending the wedding. Half way through the night I approched the groom to tell him how much I enjoyed the theme. After a few minutes of conversation we realized that we actually knew each other from playing, you guessed it, online video games!
